writes: same primary, synchronous_commit=local in both arms
measurement_boundary: VM client to isolated gateway through loopback kubectl port-forward
pair_order: random first layout, alternating order across pairs
interval: two-sided Student t over independent physical run means, 95% per class
transfer_assumption: second standby has the observed first standby's per-request CPU, local delay and replay proxy

input_arms.aggregate: database container cgroup cumulative CPU, idle-subtracted on isolated class runs
input_arms.process: PostgreSQL backend and replay-process cumulative CPU from the same isolated runs

telemetry_transport: container cgroup cpu.stat (or cpuacct.usage), because lab Prometheus access timed out
shared_measurements: client and gateway-to-SQL request times in the two low-load mixed runs
target_order: three matched blocks with alternating layout order; randomized rate order shared by layouts
physical_evidence: same stationarity proxies, decision and class SLOs as pgs1
